hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a shield mechanism (absorbs main-to-secondary sells from a funded pot at the pool's own price, returning a BeforeSwapDelta) and a pump mechanism (uses pot funds to buy back the main token on incoming buy swaps via a nested self-call), with optional auto-harvesting and auto-compounding of a hook-held LP position.
